title: Fixation of atmospheric CO2 by a dimeric lanthanum hydroxide complex; assembly of an unusual hexameric carbonate

synthesis.procedure: In a glove box, a MeCN solution of tpen (72 mg, 0.171 mmol, 5 mL) was added to a stirred MeCN suspension of La(OTf)3 (100 mg, 0.171 mmol, 6 mL). After stirring at room temperature overnight, the solution was filtered, reduced to 4 mL, and iPr2O was layered on top. After two weeks the crystals were filtered, washed with minimal MeCN and dried under vacuum suction, giving colourless microcrystalline La(tpen)(OTf)3 in 22% yield (38 mg). The main text states that one equivalent of tpen with La(OTf)3 in anhydrous or hydrous acetonitrile gives only the 1:1 complex.
synthesis.time: overnight stirring; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: glove box; stirring then iPr2O layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, concentrated to 4 mL, layered with iPr2O; crystals washed with minimal MeCN and dried under vacuum suction.

synthesis.procedure: In a glove box under argon, two equivalents of tpen (70 mg, 0.165 mmol, 5 mL) were added to a stirred acetonitrile solution of La(OTf)3 (48 mg, 0.0818 mmol, 5 mL). After 12 h, two equivalents of 0.5 M H2O in MeCN (330 μL) were added slowly over 30 min by syringe. After a further 12 h, another two equivalents of H2O were added. After another 12 h the solution was filtered, reduced to 4 mL, and iPr2O was added. After several days the crystals were collected, washed with minimal MeCN and dried under suction, giving 2 in 61% yield (45 mg). The main text alternatively describes adding a second equivalent of tpen and a stoichiometric amount of degassed water to anhydrous acetonitrile solutions of 1 under inert atmosphere, with crystals grown by slow diffusion of diisopropyl ether into 10^-2 M acetonitrile solutions at room temperature.

synthesis.procedure: Recrystallization of the hydroxo complex 2 from MeCN/iPr2O under aerobic conditions reproducibly gave the hexanuclear carbonate complex 3 by uptake of atmospheric CO2. Exposure of acetonitrile solutions of anaerobically isolated 2 to air immediately produced carbonate-containing ions, including the hexamer, as monitored by ESI-MS. No isolated yield is reported. The supplied SI gives preparations of 1 and 2 only.
synthesis.time: carbonate ions observed within a few minutes by ESI-MS; crystallization time not quantified
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated by recrystallization from MeCN/diisopropyl ether in air; lower-nuclearity carbonate species remain in solution and do not crystallize under these conditions.
